goal: Make GUI and CLI tools agree on which data directory to use so bitcoind, bitcoin-cli, and bitcoin-wallet don't diverge from a GUI-selected datadir
Fixes a real usability gap where CLI tools error out or silently use the wrong datadir after a GUI datadir choice
reviewability: Paused: author reworking, marked draft and unfinished since 2024 with no substantive update since
A confirmed Windows datadir bug remains unfixed, and an Oct 2025 rebase did not address it or the draft status
agreement: Concept approval without stated objections to the underlying goal (luke-jr, pinheadmz)
Unaddressed objection: Windows datadir detection confirmed broken, no follow-up fix (pinheadmz)
Author himself says the PR is not ready and does not expect to return to it soon (ryanofsky)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it fixes a narrow but real gap where bitcoin-wallet ignored the config file in its target datadir
Benefits users who run bitcoin-wallet directly against a non-default datadir
Mostly a supporting piece for the larger datadir-unification effort rather than a standalone improvement

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes a long-standing, broadly felt inconsistency in how every Bitcoin Core binary resolves its datadir
Benefits any user who runs both GUI and CLI tools against the same node, avoiding wrong wallets or misplaced block data
Kept at P2 rather than P1 since it's a usability/consistency fix rather than a security or crash issue
